notes.title: Nine Lives is going free!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and happy new year!

After a lot of thought and deliberation I have decided to make all of my games including Nine Lives completely free.

It has been a tough couple of years for all of us, and for me specifically it meant giving up on professional indie-game development. 

However, I'd like Nine Lives to be easily accessible to anyone who is interested in the game. With that in mind I think it's best to make this game available for free. I have asked the folks at Valve to make this change on the 15th of February 2022.

Those of you have bought the game, I can't thank you enough for your support! 

Hope you have a great 2022!

Thank you.
Siddharth

notes.title: Nine Lives is out!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to announce that Nine Lives is now available on Steam! Nine Lives is a quirky puzzle game that'll have you finding the most efficient ways to sacrifice your many lives to solve increasingly complex puzzles.

The game is divided into nine areas that you must overcome. Each introducing a new element to the core mechanic that'll have you use your lives in innovative ways.

The first four areas are also playable as part of a free demo. Do give that a go if you'd like to know what the game is like before purchasing it! Hope you enjoy playing the game and if you need help don't hesitate to post in the community forum!

Happy puzzling!

-
Sid

notes.title: Nine Lives Demo now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Nine Lives, the puzzle game where you use multiple lives to solve interesting puzzles now has a demo that is available to download! If you're curious about the game and want to know if it's something you'd enjoy, do give the demo a look. 

The demo contains 30 levels and covers four of the nine areas available, with each area introducing a new element or twist to the main mechanic. The full game comes out later this month, and if you enjoy the demo don't forget to wishlist the game!

Thanks for reading and happy gaming!
Sid
